name: Isumi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Isumi city emblem in green and blue: a green stylised bird-like swirl with a blue disc.
history: Municipal flag of Isumi, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 22 February 2018; the emblem dates from 5 December 2005.

features.role: Isumi city emblem — a green stylised bird-like swirl with a blue disc
